editorial.blurb: Upscale Mexican spot in West Loop with bold, fresh flavors and an exceptional mezcal program that's worth the trip alone.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Shrimp Tacos and Guacamole—reviewers rave about how fresh they are. Ask for limes at the table, and note that the steak salad packs serious heat (even Texans were caught off guard), so request it mild if you're spice-sensitive.
